blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification (AG-ReID) aims to match pedestrian images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and ground-based surveillance cameras. The task remains highly challenging due to severe viewpoint discrepancies, frequent occlusions, and substantial domain gaps between aerial and ground imagery. Beyond these observable factors, existing methods often overlook two fundamental structural issues: cumulative positional drift during hierarchical feature extraction and semantic inconsistency across cross-view feature distributions. To address these challenges, we propose ProAlign, a Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment Network for AG-ReID. ProAlign comprises two key components: a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module and a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module. LPPE performs adaptive positional calibration throughout transformer layers by employing conditional positional encoding in shallow layers to mitigate local spatial distortions, while introducing learnable static positional embeddings in deeper layers to reinforce global semantic priors. Meanwhile, PCL maintains view-specific aerial and ground prototypes for each identity and enforces cross-view semantic consistency via a dual-prototype contrastive objective. Extensive experiments on CARGO and two real-world AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ProAlign, achieving state-of-the-art overall retrieval performance on CARGO with improvements of 1.60% in Rank-1 accuracy and 5.01% in mAP over the strongest competing methods.
blocks.zh: Air-Ground Person Re-Identification(AG-ReID)旨在匹配无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)和地面监视摄像机捕获的行人图像. 由于存在严重的观点差异、经常被隔离以及空中和地面图像之间有很大的域位差距,这项任务仍然具有很大的挑战性。 除了这些可观察到的因素之外,现有方法往往忽略了两个基本的结构问题:等级特征提取过程中的累积位置漂移和跨视图特征分布的语义不一致。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议为AG-ReID建立一个进步立场和原型指导性对接网络。 ProAlign包含两个关键组成部分:一个面向层的累进定位嵌入模块(LPPE)和一个View-Aware原型对比学习模块(PCL). LPPE在整个变压器层中进行适应性定位校准,在浅层中采用条件性定位编码来缓解局部空间扭曲,同时在更深层中引入可学习的静态定位嵌入,强化全球语义前缀. 同时,PCL为每个身份保持了针对特定视域的空中和地面原型,并通过双原型对比目标执行交叉视域语义一致性. 关于CARGO和两个现实世界的AG-ReID基准的广泛实验表明ProAlign的有效性,在CARGO上实现了最先进的整体检索性能,比最强的相互竞争方法提高了1.60%的Rank-1精度和5.01%的mAP.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Person re-identification (ReID) aims to match pedestrian images across distributed non-overlapping cameras and has attracted extensive attention due to its broad applications in intelligent surveillance systems. While conventional ReID has achieved remarkable progress He et al. (2021) ; Li et al. (2023) ; Tan et al. (2024a) , recent advances in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and low-altitude sensing platforms have stimulated growing interest in aerial-ground ReID (AG-ReID) Nguyen et al. (2023a) ; Zhang et al. (2020) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) . Compared with traditional settings, AG-ReID introduces substantially larger viewpoint discrepancies and domain gaps between aerial and ground imagery, requiring models to establish robust cross-view identity correspondence under severe spatial and semantic variations.
blocks.zh: 人物再识别(ReID)旨在匹配分布式非重叠相机的行人图像,并因其在智能监控系统中的广泛应用而引起广泛关注. 虽然传统的ReID取得了显著进展 He等人(2021年)、Li等人(2023年)、Tan等人(2024年a年),但无人驾驶飞行器(无人驾驶飞行器)和低空感测平台的近期进展激发了对空地ReID(AG-ReID)的日益浓厚的兴趣。 Nguyen等人(2023a); 张等 (2020年); 张等 (2024b). 与传统环境相比,AG-ReID在空中和地面图像之间引入了大得多的视角差异和域位差距,要求模型在严重的空间和语义差异下建立强健的交叉视图身份对应.

blocks.en: Despite its practical importance, AG-ReID remains highly challenging and relatively underexplored. Unlike conventional ReID Tan et al. (2024c) ; Li et al. (2021b) ; Wang et al. (2025a) , aerial observations often exhibit extreme top-down viewpoints, severe occlusions, and incomplete body visibility, whereas ground images mainly contain frontal or profile appearances. Such discrepancies introduce significant geometric deformation and appearance variation across views. More importantly, these variations are not confined to the input level. As features propagate through deep Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures, early spatial deviations progressively accumulate and evolve into hierarchical positional drift, leading to unstable high-level representations. Meanwhile, the substantial appearance gap between aerial and ground domains produces systematic semantic inconsistency across feature distributions, making robust cross-view matching particularly difficult.
blocks.zh: 尽管投资促进小组具有实际重要性,但其挑战性仍然很大,而且相对未得到充分探讨。 不同于常规的ReID Tan等人(2024c);Li等人(2021b); Wang et al. (2025a),航空观测经常表现出极端的自上而下的观点,严重的隐蔽,以及不完整的身体可见度,而地面图像主要包含正面或剖面外观. 这种差异造成了显著的几何变形和不同观点的外观差异。 更重要的是,这些变化并不限于投入层面。 随着通过深视变形器(ViT)架构传播的特征,早期的空间偏差逐渐积累并演化为等级定位漂移,导致不稳定的高层代表. 同时,空域和地面域之间的巨大外观差距造成各特征分布的系统语义不一致,使强烈的交叉视差特别难以匹配。

blocks.en: Recent AG-ReID methods attempt to alleviate these issues by learning view-invariant representations or introducing geometric and semantic alignment mechanisms Nguyen et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Li et al. (2025) . Although promising, most existing approaches primarily focus on shallow feature correction or sample-level alignment, while overlooking two fundamental structural limitations. First, positional misalignment propagates progressively across transformer hierarchies, where early spatial deviations become increasingly entangled in deeper semantic representations. Second, cross-view feature distributions remain globally inconsistent, whereas instance-level supervision alone is insufficient to preserve population-level semantic structure. Consequently, existing methods often struggle under large viewpoint discrepancies and severe visibility degradation.
blocks.zh: 近期的AG-ReID方法试图通过学习观点不一致的表述或引入几何和语义对齐机制来缓解这些问题. Nguyen et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024b); Li et al. (2025). 大多数现行办法虽然很有希望,但主要侧重于浅层特征校正或样本级的校正,同时忽略了两个基本的结构限制。 首先,位置错位逐渐跨越变形器等级,早期的空间偏差越来越缠绕在更深层次的语义表达中. 第二,交叉视图特征分布在全球范围仍然不一致,而光是实例一级的监督不足以维持人口一级的语义结构。 因此,现行方法往往在大相径庭和严重可见度下降的情况下挣扎。

blocks.en:
To address the above limitations, we propose ProAlign, a Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment Network for AG-ReID, as illustrated in Figure 1 . The core idea of ProAlign is to jointly model hierarchical positional evolution and cross-view semantic structure within a unified framework.
Specifically, we introduce a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module to perform depth-adaptive positional calibration throughout transformer hierarchies. LPPE employs conditional positional encoding in shallow layers to mitigate local spatial distortions, while utilizing learnable static positional embeddings in deeper layers to reinforce stable global semantic priors. This progressive design enables the network to gradually correct spatial deviations without disrupting pretrained representations. Furthermore, we propose a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module to explicitly align aerial and ground identity distributions at the identity level. PCL maintains view-specific prototypes for each identity and updates them online through quality-aware momentum aggregation, thereby reducing the influence of noisy or occluded samples. A dual-prototype contrastive objective further encourages features from different views to converge toward shared identity-aware semantic anchors, improving cross-view consistency and discriminative capability.
blocks.zh:
为了克服上述限制,我们提议建立一个AG-ReID逐步定位和原型指导对接网络,如图1所示。 ProAlign的核心理念是在统一框架内联合建模等级位置演化和跨视图语义结构.
具体来说,我们引入了一层递进定位嵌入模块(LPPE),在整个变压器等级中进行深度适应定位校准. LPPE在浅层使用有条件的位置编码来减轻局部空间扭曲,同时利用可学习的静态位置嵌入更深层来强化稳定的全球语义前缀. 这种渐进式设计使得网络能够逐渐纠正空间偏差,而不会中断预先训练的表示. 此外,我们提议采用Video-Aware原型对照学习模块,明确调整身份一级的空中和地面身份分布。 PCL为每个身份保持了针对特定视图的原型,并通过质感动力聚合在线更新,从而降低吵闹或占卜样本的影响. 双重原型的对比性目标进一步鼓励不同观点的特征趋同到共同的认知语义锚,提高交叉视角的一致性和歧视能力.

blocks.en: To sum up, the main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We propose ProAlign, a unified framework for aerial-ground person re-identification that jointly addresses hierarchical positional drift and cross-view semantic inconsistency under extreme viewpoint variations. • We introduce a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module and a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module. LPPE progressively calibrates spatial representations across transformer layers, while PCL performs prototype-guided population-level semantic alignment across views. • Extensive experiments on multiple AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate that ProAlign achieves state-of-the-art overall performance and exhibits strong robustness under challenging aerial-ground matching scenarios.
blocks.zh: 总之,本文件的主要贡献如下: 我们提议建立一个统一的空中地面人员重新确定身份的框架,在极端观点差异下共同处理等级定位漂移和交叉视野语义不一致问题。 我们采用了一个面向层的累进定位嵌入模块和一个视图-软件原型对照学习模块。 LPPE逐渐校准跨变压器层的空间表示,而PCL则进行原型的人群级语义对视. · 对多个AG-ReID基准的广泛试验表明,ProAlign公司在具有挑战性的空中地面比对方案下,实现了最先进的总体性能,并表现出强大的活力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Building upon well-established ground surveillance infrastructure, ReID has achieved significant progress in a variety of settings, including occluded scenarios Wang et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021b) ; Tan et al. (2024b) ; Ye et al. (2024) , cross-modal scenarios Shao et al. (2023) ; Qin et al. (2024) ; Zhao et al. (2024) ; Luo et al. (2025) , multi-spectral scenarios Wang et al. (2022) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Wang et al. (2025c) , and cross-spectral scenarios Kim et al. (2023) ; Tan et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Zhang and Wang (2023) ; Ren and Zhang (2024) . Despite these advances, most existing methods are designed under relatively stable camera viewpoints and limited cross-domain variation. With the rapid deployment of UAVs and low-altitude platforms, person ReID has been extended to aerial scenarios Nguyen et al. (2023b) . Early works mainly explored aerial-aerial retrieval using datasets such as UAV-Human Li et al. (2021a) and PRAI-1581 Zhang et al. (2020) . More recently, AG-ReID has attracted increasing attention due to its practical importance. This setting introduces severe viewpoint disparities and cross-view semantic inconsistencies, leading to substantial degradation in identity-preserving features Schumann and Metzler (2017) . To address these challenges, recent methods explore view-invariant representation learning and cross-view alignment. Nguyen et al. Nguyen et al. (2023a) ; Nguyen et al. (2024) propose attribute-guided multi-stream architectures. Zhang et al. Zhang et al. (2024b) introduce a View-Decoupled Transformer to separate view-specific and view-invariant features. GSAlign Li et al. (2025) further models geometric deformation and visibility-aware alignment.
Several recent works explicitly address geometric alignment: SeCap Wang et al. (2025b) and GeoReID Hambarde and Proença (2026) incorporate geometry-conditioned alignment, while GSAlign Li et al. (2025) models geometric deformation and visibility-aware alignment via TPS structures. Furthermore, while memory-bank and prototype-based contrastive learning have been widely explored in conventional ReID, directly adapting these instance-level and global-memory mechanisms to AG-ReID often suffers from cross-view noise and domain gaps.
However, these methods primarily focus on input-level correction or instance-level alignment, while overlooking two structural issues: cumulative positional drift across transformer layers and global distributional inconsistency between aerial and ground representations. To address these limitations, we propose ProAlign , which jointly performs depth-adaptive positional calibration and prototype-guided cross-view alignment within a unified framework.

blocks.en: To improve geometric robustness and mitigate cumulative positional drift, we integrate a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module into the transformer backbone. LPPE performs depth-adaptive positional calibration by applying conditional encodings in shallow layers and learnable static embeddings in deeper layers, progressively correcting pose-induced geometric distortions across network depth. PCL maintains quality-weighted prototypes that dynamically aggregate discriminative features, pulling samples toward consistent identity subspaces. This design effectively bridges the cross-view semantic gap while suppressing noise from background clutter and occlusions.

blocks.en: 3.2 Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding
blocks.zh: 3.2 逐层递进位置嵌入

blocks.en: To address spatial misalignment in person re-identification, we design a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module that explicitly models geometric variations induced by viewpoint discrepancies. By injecting positional corrections at each transformer layer, LPPE prevents early spatial offsets from accumulating and degrading deep representations. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , LPPE is integrated into each transformer block to enable hierarchical, depth-adaptive spatial alignment. Shallow layers primarily correct local spatial distortions, while deeper layers progressively reinforce global semantic positional priors.
blocks.zh: 为了解决人员重新识别的空间错位问题,我们设计了一个面向层的累进位置嵌入模块(LPPE),该模块明确模拟了视距差异引起的几何变化。 通过在每个变压器层注入位置校正,LPPE防止早期空间抵消积累和降低深度表示. 如图2所示,LPPE被集成到每个变压器块中,以便能够进行分级,深度适应的空间对齐. 浅层主要纠正局部空间扭曲,而更深层则逐步强化全球语义位置前缀.

blocks.en: 3.3 View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 视图-软件原型对照学习

blocks.en: In AG-ReID, severe viewpoint variations introduce a substantial distributional gap between aerial and ground representations of the same identity. Direct sample-to-sample alignment is often unreliable due to occlusions and background noise. To address this issue, we propose View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL), which explicitly models population-level identity distributions to bridge the cross-view semantic gap. PCL maintains a momentum-updated memory bank that anchors each identity in a shared prototype space, thereby improving global feature consistency while reducing the influence of noisy samples.
blocks.zh: 在AG-ReID中,严重的观点差异在同样身份的空中和地面表述之间造成了巨大的分配差距。 直接的样本到样本的对齐往往不可靠,因为存在隐蔽和背景噪音. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出Video-Aware原型对照学习(PCL),它明确模拟人口层面的身份分布,以弥合跨视图语义差距. PCL维持一个动力更新的内存库,将每个身份固定在一个共享的原型空间中,从而改善全球特征的一致性,同时降低吵闹样品的影响.

We set α = β = 1.0 \alpha=\beta=1.0 , γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 , m = 0.2 m=0.2 , and apply CPE to the first 6 layers and static embeddings to the remaining 6. All experiments are conducted on an Ubuntu 20.04 system with an Intel Xeon Gold 6133 CPU @ 2.50GHz and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU. The implementation is based on Python 3.8 and PyTorch 1.12.0 with CUDA 12.0.

blocks.en: We compare ProAlign with a range of state-of-the-art person ReID methods on the CARGO dataset, including CNN-based approaches (e.g., PCB ( Sun et al., 2019 ) , BoT ( Luo et al., 2019 ) , MGN ( Wang et al., 2018 ) ), Transformer-based models (e.g., ViT ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ) , VDT ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) , VIF ( Khalid et al., 2025 ) ), and the alignment-based GSAlign ( Li et al., 2025 ) . As shown in Table 1 , ProAlign achieves the best Rank-1, mAP and mINP under the ALL, G ↔ \leftrightarrow G and A ↔ \leftrightarrow A protocols. Under ALL, it obtains 68.27% Rank-1, 62.47% mAP and 51.39% mINP, outperforming GSAlign by +1.60%, +6.12% and +9.97%, respectively. On the challenging A ↔ \leftrightarrow G protocol, ProAlign improves over its VDT baseline by +12.52% Rank-1, +15.69% mAP and +19.91% mINP, and achieves the best mINP (49.86%). GSAlign obtains higher A ↔ \leftrightarrow G Rank-1 and mAP through explicit TPS-based geometric warping, but at the cost of 25.7M additional parameters (Table 6 ), whereas ProAlign adds only 1.01M and requires no geometric transformation. Notably, ProAlign also improves single-view protocols, indicating that the proposed alignment does not sacrifice intra-view retrieval.

blocks.en: To evaluate the contribution of each component in ProAlign, we conduct an ablation study on all four protocols of the CARGO dataset. As shown in Table 2 , we start from the VDT baseline ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) . LPPE alone yields large gains on the cross-view A ↔ \leftrightarrow G protocol (+5.07 Rank-1, +9.88 mAP, +14.78 mINP) and improves G ↔ \leftrightarrow G mAP/mINP, but it reduces Rank-1 on ALL and the intra-view protocols, as well as A ↔ \leftrightarrow A mAP/mINP. We attribute this to the fact that, without identity-level cross-view supervision, the newly introduced positional parameters are optimized mainly toward viewpoint-invariant spatial layouts, which slightly weakens view-specific cues useful for intra-view matching. Note that the A ↔ \leftrightarrow A protocol contains only 40 queries, so each query changes Rank-1 by 2.5% (the − 7.50 -7.50 drop corresponds to three queries). PCL alone improves ALL (+1.28/+3.35/+5.36) and substantially improves A ↔ \leftrightarrow G (+10.39/+14.90/+19.73), showing that prototype alignment is independently effective, although it slightly lowers G ↔ \leftrightarrow G Rank-1. Combining both gives the best result on every metric of every protocol, including all intra-view metrics where LPPE alone falls behind (e.g., A ↔ \leftrightarrow A Rank-1 from 75.00 to 85.00). This indicates that the two modules are complementary: PCL anchors the identity semantics so that LPPE’s spatial calibration no longer trades off intra-view discrimination.
blocks.zh: 为了评价ProAlign中每个组成部分的贡献,我们对CARGO数据集的所有四项协议都进行了消化研究。 如表2所示,我们从VDT基线开始(Zhang等人,2024年b)。 单LPPE在横视图 A \\ 左右翼 G 协议(+ 5.07 Rank-1,+ 9.88 mAP,+14.78 mINP)上产生很大收益,并改进了 G \\ 左翼 Rankarrow G mAP/ mINP,但它在全和内视图协议上降低了 Rank-1,以及 A \\ 左翼 Rankarrow A mAP/ mINP. 我们将此归因于这样一个事实,即没有身份级别的交叉视图监督,新引入的位置参数主要是面向视角-不变量的空间布局优化,这略微弱化了视图特定提示对于视角内部匹配有用的. 注意 A \\\ 左右旋 A 协议中仅包含40个查询,因此每个查询会将 Rank-1 更改2.5%( − 7. 50 - 7. 50 的下降对应三个查询) 。 PCL单独改进了ALL(+1.28+3.35/+5.36),并大幅度改进了A \\ 左右翼G(+10.39/+14.90/+19.73),表明原型对齐是独立有效的,虽然略降低G \ \ 左翼G Rank-1. 两者结合,就每个协议的每个度量,包括仅LPPE落后的所有内视度量(例如,从75.00到85.00的A \\ left rightarrow A Rank-1),得出最佳结果. 这表明这两个模块是互补的:PCL锁定身份语义,使LPPE的空间校准不再与视内歧视作交易.

blocks.en: Depth of Conditional Positional Encoding in LPPE. We vary the number of transformer layers equipped with CPE while using static positional embeddings for the remaining layers (Table 3 ). We select the configuration by a predefined criterion, the best ALL-protocol mAP/mINP, rather than per-protocol tuning. Applying CPE to the first six layers achieves the best mAP/mINP on ALL, G ↔ \leftrightarrow G and A ↔ \leftrightarrow A. Using CPE only in the first three layers yields the highest ALL and G ↔ \leftrightarrow G Rank-1 but lower mAP/mINP, while deeper CPE (first nine layers) gives the best A ↔ \leftrightarrow G results. Applying CPE to all layers yields the lowest ALL mINP (45.41%), suggesting that input-conditioned encoding throughout the network weakens overall ranking quality. These results reveal a trade-off between intra-view and cross-view retrieval across CPE depths; the first-six configuration offers the best overall balance. Rank-1 differences are partly within the granularity of CARGO’s small query sets (one query changes A ↔ \leftrightarrow A Rank-1 by 2.5%). Notably, the full model with every CPE depth outperforms the VDT baseline on ALL mAP/mINP (Table 2 ), and all variants preserve spatial focus in the middle layers (Table 7 ).

blocks.en: Impact of cross-view alignment weight in PCL. The weight γ \gamma controls the trade-off between intra-view discrimination and cross-view alignment (Table 4 ). Without cross-view supervision ( γ = 0 \gamma=0 ), the model attains the highest A ↔ \leftrightarrow G Rank-1 but the lowest ALL mAP/mINP (57.24%/42.85%) and clearly lower A ↔ \leftrightarrow G mAP/mINP, indicating that it retrieves the easiest cross-view matches but ranks the remaining true matches poorly. Increasing γ \gamma to 0.5 steadily improves ALL, G ↔ \leftrightarrow G and A ↔ \leftrightarrow A, reaching 62.47% mAP and 51.39% mINP on ALL, while A ↔ \leftrightarrow G Rank-1 decreases moderately. Further increasing γ \gamma to 0.75 degrades ALL and G ↔ \leftrightarrow G performance without improving A ↔ \leftrightarrow G, suggesting that overly strong alignment suppresses discriminative identity cues. We therefore adopt γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 following the same ALL-based selection criterion.
blocks.zh: PCL中的交叉视图对齐权重的影响. 权重 γ\gamma 控制着视内歧视和对视比的权衡(表4). 在没有交叉视图监督(γ=0\gamma=0)的情况下,该型号获得最高的A \\\右翼G Rank-1,但最低的All mAP/mINP(57.24%/42.85%),并明显低于A \\左翼G mAP/mINP,表明它回收了最简单的交叉视图匹配,但将剩下的真实匹配排列得很差. 将 γ\gamma 提升到 0.5 稳步改善 ALL, G\\ 左右翼 G 和 A\ \ 左右翼 A, 达到 62.47% mAP 和 51.39% mINP 在 ALL上, A\ \ 左翼 G Rank-1 中度下降 。 将 γ\gamma 进一步提升到 0.75 将 All 和 G\\\ 左右翼 G 的性能降低,而不改进 A\\\\ 左翼 G ,说明过于强烈的对齐会抑制歧视性的身份提示. 因此,我们采用相同的基于全方位的选择标准,采用γ=0.5\gamma=0.5。

blocks.en: Comparison of prototype variants. We evaluate different prototype construction strategies, including Inner-Batch, Global Memory, Classifier Weights, and our View-Aware PCL. As shown in Table 5 , clear performance gaps appear across all four protocols. Compared with Inner-Batch prototypes, which achieve 62.82% Rank-1 and 56.12% mAP under the ALL protocol, Global Memory slightly reduces performance to 61.86% Rank-1 and 55.40% mAP, indicating that global averaging introduces noise from occluded or low-quality samples. Classifier Weights achieve baseline performance comparable to Inner-Batch under the ALL protocol (62.82% Rank-1), but generalize poorly to cross-view retrieval, dropping to 53.19% Rank-1 on A ↔ \leftrightarrow G. This suggests that classification-oriented prototypes are suboptimal for cross-view discrimination. In contrast, our View-Aware PCL achieves the best results on ALL, G ↔ \leftrightarrow G and A ↔ \leftrightarrow A, improving ALL Rank-1 by +5.45% over Inner-Batch and Classifier Weights, and G ↔ \leftrightarrow G mINP by +7.43% over the strongest variant. On A ↔ \leftrightarrow G, it matches Inner-Batch in Rank-1 and achieves the best mINP, while outperforming Global Memory and Classifier Weights by +4.26% and +7.45% Rank-1, respectively. These results indicate that single-prototype designs are insufficient for aerial-ground matching, and that decoupling view-specific prototypes mainly improves overall ranking quality and intra-view discrimination while remaining competitive in cross-view retrieval.
blocks.zh: 原型变体比较. 我们评价不同的原型构建策略,包括内存,全球记忆,分类器重量,以及我们的Video-Aware PCL. 如表5所示,所有四项议定书都有明显的性能差距。 与All协议下实现62.82% Rank-1和56.12% mAP的内框原型相比,Global Memory将性能略微降低到61.86% Rank-1和55.40% mAP,表明全球平均引入了来自奥氏或低质量样本的噪声. 分类器重量在All协议(62.82% Rank-1)下实现了与内框相当的基线性能,但概括性差于交叉视图检索,在A QQ\\右旋G上下降到53.19% Rank-1. 这表明,面向分类的原型对于交叉观点歧视来说是次优的. 相比之下,我们的Video-Aware PCL在All,G \\ 左右翼 G和A \ \ 左右翼 A上取得了最佳成绩,使All Rank-1比内框和分类器重量提高+5.45%,G \\ 左翼右翼 G mINP比最强的变体提高+7.43%. A \\ 左右旋 G 上, 它与 Rank-1 的内框匹配, 并实现最佳 mINP, 而表现优于 Global Memory 和 Classider Weights 的 + 4.26% 和 + 7.45% Rank-1 。 这些结果显示,单原型设计不足以进行空地比对,脱钩的视点特有原型主要提高了整体排名质量和视点内的歧视,同时在交叉视点检索方面保持竞争力.

blocks.en: Computational Complexity Analysis. We analyze the computational efficiency of ProAlign in terms of trainable parameters, FLOPs, and inference latency, and compare it with VDT ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) and GSAlign ( Li et al., 2025 ) under the same input resolution ( 256 × 128 256\times 128 ) and hardware configuration. ProAlign introduces additional parameters of 1.01M compared to VDT, which are contributed by the Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module, including depthwise 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions, layer-specific positional embeddings, and learnable gating scalars. The Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module does not introduce additional trainable parameters at inference time, as the prototype memory is maintained as non-trainable buffers used only during training. In terms of computational cost, ProAlign requires 74.69 GFLOPs per forward pass. Despite the increased computation, the inference latency remains comparable, increasing by only 0.06 ms (0.54%). In contrast, GSAlign introduces 25.7M additional parameters for TPS-based warping and increases latency by 2.23%, whereas ProAlign achieves competitive alignment with substantially lower complexity and without relying on explicit geometric transformation.

ProAlign引入了与 VDT 相比1.01M 的额外参数,这些参数是由 LPPE 模块(LPPE)贡献的,包括 深度 3× 3 3\ 3 时 3 折叠 , 层特异性位置嵌入, 以及可学习的 Gating scalars 。 原型对比学习(PCL)模块在推论时间没有引入额外的可训练参数,因为原型内存作为非可训练缓冲器保留下来,只在训练期间使用. 在计算成本方面,ProAlign每前传需要74.69 GFLOP. 尽管计算增加了,但推论的延迟性仍然具有可比性,只增加了0.06毫秒(0.54%). 相比之下,GSAlign为基于TPS的拼写引入了25.7M的额外参数,并增加了2.23%的耐久性,而ProAlign则实现了复杂程度低得多且不依赖显式几何转换的竞争性对齐.

blocks.en: Feature Distribution Analysis. We further analyze the learned feature space to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed PCL module. Following standard practice, we extract deep features from the test set and visualize their distributions using t-SNE, as shown in Fig. 3 . The baseline model exhibits a clear view-dependent clustering pattern, where samples are primarily grouped by viewpoint rather than identity. As a result, features of the same identity are scattered across different regions, indicating a pronounced cross-view semantic gap and insufficient sample-level alignment under large viewpoint variations. In contrast, ProAlign produces a more structured embedding space. Features become significantly more identity-consistent, with aerial and ground samples of the same person forming compact and unified clusters. Meanwhile, inter-identity boundaries become more distinct, suggesting improved discriminability. These observations suggest that the proposed framework improves cross-view feature consistency and identity discrimination.
blocks.zh: 特色分布分析. 我们进一步分析学到的特征空间,以评估拟议的PCL模块的有效性。 按照标准惯例,我们从测试集中提取深层特征,并使用t-SNE来直观其分布,如图3所示. 基线模型显示了一种明显依赖视线的集群模式,样本主要按视线而不是身份进行分组。 因此,同一特征的特征分散在不同区域,表明在大视差下存在明显的交叉视图语义差距和样本级对齐不足. 相比之下,ProAlign则产生一个更有结构化的嵌入空间. 特征变得明显与身份一致,同一人的空中和地面样本形成紧凑和统一的集群. 与此同时,身份间界限变得更加明确,表明歧视性得到提高。 这些意见表明,拟议框架改善了交叉观点的一致性和身份歧视。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose ProAlign for aerial-ground person re-identification, which addresses positional drift and semantic inconsistency in cross-view scenarios. By introducing a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) and a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL), the model performs depth-adaptive positional calibration and population-level semantic alignment within a unified framework. Extensive experiments on the CARGO dataset demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple protocols. We further evaluate generalization on the AG-ReID and AG-ReID v2 datasets, where consistent improvements are observed, validating the robustness of our approach under real-world cross-view variations and domain gaps.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议重新确定空中地面人员的身份,以解决跨视情景中位置漂移和语义不一致的问题。 该模型通过采用层向递进定位嵌入法(LPPE)和视图-Aware原型对照学习法(PCL),在一个统一的框架内进行深度适应定位校准和人口级语义对齐。 在CARGO数据集上的广泛实验显示了跨多个协议的最新性能. 我们进一步评价AG-ReID和AG-ReID v2数据集的概况,在这些数据集中观察到一致的改进,验证了我们在现实世界交叉视野变化和域间差距下的做法的稳健性。

blocks.en: 6 Limitation and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 6 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en:
Despite achieving state-of-the-art performance in AG-ReID, ProAlign still has several limitations that merit further investigation. First, the Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) relies on a predefined partition between conditional and static positional encodings across network depth. Such a fixed design lacks instance-level adaptivity and may be sub-optimal under varying degrees of spatial deformation across different samples.
Second, the View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module updates prototypes using mini-batch statistics. As a result, its cross-view alignment is inherently constrained by batch composition; when an identity does not have paired samples across views within a batch, the corresponding contrastive supervision cannot be fully exploited. Future work will explore more adaptive designs, including instance-aware dynamic gating for positional calibration and cross-batch memory mechanisms to decouple prototype learning from individual batch constraints, thereby improving robustness in more complex and large-scale real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh:
尽管在AG-ReID中取得了最先进的业绩,但ProAlign仍然有一些局限性值得进一步调查。 首先,图层递进定位嵌入(LPPE)依赖于在跨网络深度的有条件和静态定位编码之间预先设定的分区. 这种固定设计缺乏实例一级的适应性,在不同样本的不同空间变形程度下可能不够理想。
其次,Video-Aware原型对比学习(PCL)模块利用小批量统计更新原型. 因此,它的交叉视距一致在本质上受到批次构成的限制;当一个身份在批次内没有在各种观点之间配对时,相应的对比性监督不能被充分利用. 今后的工作将探索更具适应性的设计,包括用于定位校准的实例意识动态定位和交叉批量存储机制,以解开原型从单个批量约束中学习,从而在更为复杂和大规模的现实世界情景中提高稳健性.

blocks.en: Effectiveness Analysis of the LPPE Module. We visualize attention maps to analyze the effect of the Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module by comparing the baseline VDT with its LPPE-enhanced variant. As shown in Fig. 4 , the baseline model exhibits scattered attention and frequently focuses on background regions, indicating severe spatial misalignment under large viewpoint changes. In contrast, ProAlign produces more concentrated and accurate attention distributions, consistently focusing on the target person under both aerial and ground views. This suggests that LPPE effectively improves spatial correspondence by progressively correcting positional deviations across transformer layers, leading to more stable and reliable feature localization in cross-view scenarios.

blocks.en: A.4 Further Analysis of Spatial Attention
blocks.zh: A.4 空间注意力的进一步分析

blocks.en: This section extends the entropy analysis in Sec. 4.4 . As shown in Table 7 , all LPPE variants follow a consistent layer-wise pattern. In the shallow layers (3–5), the entropy remains close to uniform ( ≥ \geq 0.958) for all variants, which is expected since these layers mainly encode low-level texture rather than semantic body parts. The entropy then drops markedly in the middle layers (7–10), where semantic part representations emerge and spatial correspondence matters most, and rises again in Layer 11 (0.93–0.99), suggesting renewed attention to broader contextual information in deeper representations. The VDT baseline, by contrast, remains near-uniform in all layers, indicating that without positional calibration its global token never recovers spatial selectivity. This spatial focus is also reflected in retrieval performance: LPPE-0.5, the configuration adopted in ProAlign, attains the lowest entropy in Layers 7–9, which coincides with its best ALL mAP/mINP in Table 3 , suggesting that sharper focus in the middle layers translates into better overall ranking quality.

blocks.en: These results also explain why LPPE calibrates only the patch tokens. The class and view tokens have no spatial coordinates and therefore cannot drift in the same sense as patch tokens; they access spatial information only through attention. Once LPPE calibrates the patch tokens, the global tokens attend to more informative regions without direct modification, as reflected by the reduced [CLS] entropy. Finally, we note that lower entropy measures how concentrated the attention is rather than whether it falls on the correct region. We therefore complement it with the attention visualizations in Fig. 4 , which confirm that the concentrated regions lie on the person rather than the background.
